title: Song - Passion Chorale (simplified)
composer: H. L. Hassler (tune "Passion Chorale", as J. S. Bach set it)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: The Passion Chorale in D minor, with its one-beat pickup, over one held block chord a bar in the left (Dm, Gm, C).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-107-passion-chorale: Choral "O Haupt voll Blut und Wunden" from the St Matthew Passion (J. S. Bach), SATB with piano, D minor; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=107)
provenance.note: Melody from Edition Peters (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=107), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the chords of a beginner minor song only (Dm, Gm, C), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 60 instead of 72 quarter notes a minute.
The fermatas at the ends of the phrases are left out: the music goes on in time.
